title: Day-of-Ops Ticker + Crash Cart Checklist (Apr 2027, WIP)
content:
Purpose:
This is the day-of-ops ticker and the "crash-cart" checklist for the Apr 8, 2027 quiet-launch of runtime/optimizer v3.12. Intended audience: release conductor, SRE on-call, serving-runtime owners, product PMs on watch.

Status: DRAFT — final runbook will be pushed after the Apr 6 rehearsal. This doc is intentionally terse; use it as the live minute-by-minute guide.

Overview:
- Scope: small-batch rollout (0.5% -> 10% over 90m) for model-routing and caching heuristics. No schema migration, no client SDK changes.
- Primary goal: validate latency p50/p95 under steady traffic and confirm cache warmup behavior.
- Risk profile: moderate (routing fallback complexity). Have model-variant fallback and regional fallback ready.

Pre-launch checklist (T-72h -> T-1h):
- [ ] Confirm canary image digest in release template (runtime:v3.12-rc8). (Owner: Elena)
- [ ] Confirm autoscale policy patch staged in Dedicated pool (PR 3182 merged to staging). (Owner: Marcus)
- [ ] Confirm smoke test suite green on staging and small-scale perf runs (tooling: perf-runner). (Owner: Priya)
- [ ] Deploy monitoring dashboards to watchlist (console: /dashboards/release-2027-04). (Owner: Liam)
- [ ] Ensure DB read replicas for routing metadata are warmed and below 50ms. (Owner: infra)
- [ ] Notify customer-success for watchlist coverage (two customers: Acme/Sigma). (Owner: CS)

Day-of ticker (UTC):
- 08:00 - Preflight standup (10m): confirm owners, op-roles, Slack channel pinned messages, crash-cart lead named.
- 08:10 - Final smoke (10m): run minimal smoke-plan against staging + small load; abort if any critical failures.
- 08:25 - Canary deploy start (kickoff): push 0.5% routing rule for region-us-west.
- 08:30 - T+5m: initial telemetry check (errors, latency, request-drop).
- 08:40 - T+15m: expand to 2% if gate OK (see gating below).
- 09:00 - T+35m: expand to 5% if gate OK.
- 09:30 - T+65m: expand to 10% if gate OK.
- 10:00 - Observability sweep + retrospective notes (30m).

Gating thresholds (immediate abort if any triggered):
- Error rate (5xx) > 0.5% sustained for 3 minutes for the canary cohort.
- P95 latency regression > 250ms relative to baseline for 5 minutes.
- Drop rate (client-side retries / refused connections) > 0.3% for 5 minutes.
- Any new regression in end-to-end test cases (semantic drift seen in eval harness).

Crash-cart (immediate actions when a gate is violated):
1) Set Slack channel to "CRITICAL" with header: "CRASH CART: canary -> pause -> rollback candidate" and ping @oncall and @release-conductor.
2) Pause traffic ramp: flip routing rule to previous stable variant (runtime:v3.11) for affected region. 
3) If pause fails or routing stuck, scale up model-variant fallback nodes in region (infra-scale command below).
4) Run emergency smoke tests against stable variant to confirm restore.
5) Open incident ticket (RT-<new>) and assign severity: Sev2 if >1 minute customer impact, Sev1 if widespread.
6) Post-mortem owner assigned by release conductor (within 2 business days).

Quick rollback commands (ops snippets):
- Pause ramp (routing): curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY" https://api.redwood/release/routing/pause -d '{"release":"v3.12-rc8","region":"us-west"}'
- Force variant switch: ./tools/routing-swap --env prod --region us-west --from v3.12-rc8 --to v3.11-stable
- Scale fallback pool: terraform apply -var "pool=fallback-us-west" -auto-approve
(These are reference commands; we rely on documented runbooks in infra repo for production.)

Telemetry checklist (monitorers to verify every check):
- [ ] p50/p95 token latencies (runtime) by route and model (Liam)
- [ ] Errors/5xx by code and by host (Elena)
- [ ] Request volume and sampling of KV-cache-hit ratio (Priya)
- [ ] Eviction/oom events in GPU hosts (infra)
- [ ] Logs: increased truncation or partial outputs (runtime team)

Smoke test checklist (automated + manual):
- [ ] Basic generation smoke (sanity prompts: 5 seeds).
- [ ] Streaming handshake for tool-calls (simulate slow client).
- [ ] Embedding vector stability (sampled vectors compare to baseline tolerance).
- [ ] Session resume / KV cache correctness (prefetch + resume test).
- [ ] Admin APIs: rollout/status endpoints respond under 200ms.

Release notes draft (to be cleaned post-launch):
- Title: runtime & routing optimizations v3.12 (Apr 2027 small-batch launch)
- Highlights:
  - Improved routing fallback heuristics to reduce cold-start latency by ~12% (internal metric).
  - Prefix KV-cache batching enabled for eligible LLM families which reduces per-token cost on warm workloads.
  - Autoscale improvements: faster warm-up path for dedicated pools.
- Known issues / caveats:
  - Slightly different tokenization corner-case for very short prompts (<=5 tokens) — monitored, regression tests added (RT-4323).
  - Canary observed trace-level noise in us-west only; team to confirm instrumentation.
- Rollout Plan: staged 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% -> 10% over 90m with regional fallback.
- Upgrade impact: no client SDK changes; server-side only.

Post-release tasks (T+1h -> T+72h):
- [ ] Consolidate timeline and annotate what telemetry triggered scaling. (Owner: Liam)
- [ ] Submit release digest for product and CS (short TL;DR + watchlist). (Owner: Priya)
- [ ] Tag release in git + create release artifact. (Owner: Marcus)
- [ ] Schedule 48h follow-up to check for flapping errors (SRE).

Open questions / TODOs (work-in-progress):
- Who is authorized to execute terraform scale during crash-cart in a midnight window? (Pending answer from infra managers.)
- Should we add an automated circuit-breaker that rolls back at the routing layer after N failed health checks? (Proposal: evaluated in next sprint.)
- Verify that customer metrics exporters (ACME/SIGMA) will not be mis-attributed during ramp (Elena to confirm).

Rehearsal notes (Apr 6 dry-run):
- Perf-runner showed a transient p95 blip after warm-up — plausible due to cache warming. Recommendation: increase initial ramp dwell from 5m -> 10m for first region.
- Infra needed an additional IAM permission to run fallback-swap command; ticket created (RT-4330).

Appendix: contacts / responsibilities (live):
- Release conductor: Priya Nair (Slack: @priya)
- SRE lead / telemetry: Liam O'Connor (Slack: @liam)
